recipes.name: Kettle Corn inspired by Community
ingredients: For the Sweet and Spicy Kettle Corn
1 serrano pepper (or pepper of your choice), halved
instructions: For the Classic Kettle Corn
Add the oil to a large stockpot. - 3 tbsp neutral oil
Begin heating the oil over medium-high and allow the oil to heat for 1 minute.
Add 2 or 3 kernels to the oil and once they pop, add all the remaining kernels. - ⅓ cup popcorn kernels
While gently shaking the pot with one hand, slowly stream in the sugar. - ¼ cup sugar
Cover the pot with a lid and continuously shake the pot until all of the kernels have popped.
Transfer the kettle corn to a large rimmed baking sheet. Spread the popcorn out to ensure the kettle corn doesn’t clump together. Season with salt to taste. - As needed kosher salt
Serve immediately.
For the Churro Kettle Corn
Add the oil and cinnamon sticks to a large stockpot. - 3 tbsp neutral oil - 2 sticks cinnamon
Begin heating the oil over low heat. Let the oil infuse for 5 minutes.
Carefully remove the cinnamon sticks.
Increase the heat to medium-high and allow the oil to heat for 1 minute.
Add 2 or 3 kernels to the oil and once they pop, add all the remaining kernels. - ⅓ cup popcorn kernels
While gently shaking the pot with one hand, slowly stream in the sugar. - ¼ cup sugar
Cover the pot with a lid and continuously shake the pot until all of the kernels have popped.
Transfer the kettle corn to a large rimmed baking sheet. Spread the popcorn out to ensure the kettle corn doesn’t clump together. Season with salt to taste. - As needed kosher salt
Serve immediately.
